target.statement: PTD-SQL + Deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct achieves 76.7% execution accuracy on Spider-dev

compute.basis: Requires fine-tuning Llama-2-7b with LoRA (GPU needed), generating targeted drilling banks via LLM inference, and running inference on 1034 Spider-dev questions with a 6.7B model; on CPU this would be extremely slow, likely hours to days.

blockers: Fine-tuning Llama-2-7b requires GPU (16GB VRAM minimum)
Generating targeted drilling banks requires LLM inference (could use API but cost/time)
Running inference on 1034 questions with 6.7B model on CPU is impractical
title: PTD-SQL: Partitioning and Targeted Drilling with LLMs in Text-to-SQL
